description: This file contains C code that defines a data model creation function, which constructs an XML representation of device configuration parameters and object structures for an EPON (Ethernet Passive Optical Network) agent. It primarily builds a nested data structure with various parameters related to device info, firmware, chip info, ONU link statistics, and more, using functions like DMPackCreatePNode, DMPackCreateNode, DMPackCreateObject, and others.

methods.name: PVOID DMPackCreateDataModelXML()
methods.description: Creates and returns an XML node object representing the entire data model for the EPON agent, including device info, firmware info, chip info, ONU link statistics, and other device parameters.
